steel.label: Brushed steel
steel.style: Brushed steel, in the manner of a heavy sci-fi board game: bevelled metal plates with fine scuffs and realistic lighting, the green showing as enamelled panels set into the steel, and a softly glowing name banner.

industrial.label: Worn industrial
industrial.style: Worn megacorp heavy industry: riveted steel plates, yellow-and-black hazard edging, grime, oil stains and chipped dark green paint.

megacorp.label: Clean megacorp
megacorp.style: Clean corporate future: white ceramic and frosted glass, soft diffuse light, very precise seams, thin dark green inlays, restrained and expensive.

circuit.label: Circuit-etched
circuit.style: A metal frame with finely etched circuit traces running through dark green solder-mask, with small gold contact pads at the corners and along the band.

holo.label: Holo-foil
holo.style: An iridescent holographic foil frame with a light rainbow sheen over dark green, like a premium foil collectible card, clean and luminous.

deco.label: Art deco megacorp
deco.style: Art deco megacorp: polished brass and cream enamel with stepped geometry, sunburst corner details and dark green lacquer, 1930s skyscraper grandeur.

painted.label: Painted
painted.style: Hand-painted in gouache and ink in the spirit of a lush illustrated board game: warm, visibly brushed, organic edges, a hand-drawn feel, illustrated rather than rendered, with moss and pine greens.

blueprint.label: Blueprint-tech
blueprint.style: A technical drawing brought into the physical world: drafting-film and cyanotype panels held in a slim dark green metal frame, fine construction lines and registration ticks, but no dimensions, numbers or lettering.

bioreactor.label: Lab glass (added)
bioreactor.style: A sealed laboratory instrument: thick bottle-green glass over a dark metal chassis, cool edge light through the glass, small gauges reduced to blank dials, sterile and slightly ominous.

patina.label: Verdigris copper (added)
patina.style: An old machine from a future museum: copper and bronze plates with a rich verdigris green patina, hammered texture, warm highlights on the worn edges.
